Cheap and tacky knockoff, SUPER tiny and garish light. Another worthless import from Western Taiwan. This horrible ring light is a joke. It's got a cheap metal clip that is thin and weak and had razor sharp edges, and awkward USB interface for power, and feels like it will break within a year. NOT WORTH THE MONEY. STOP BUYING GARBAGE FROM CHINA.
